observations: The first public flight started in the city with three companions and completed system speech. The browser timed out waiting for navigation to Dragonspine.
A subsequent cold city entry reported Timed out while preparing the spawn collision ring. The application did not reach its ready state.

regression.method: Hold the city worker script request open. Launch the city and check that collision BVHs exist while the request is pending. Release the request and observe measured worker-built chunks in the running game.
